Observer

Watches a run.

pub trait Observer: Send + Sync {
    /// The item type.
    type Item: Clone;

    /// The most items kept.
    const LIMIT: usize = 64;

    /// Makes a default observer.
    fn make() -> Self where Self: Sized;

    /// Ends the run.
    fn finish(self) -> u32 where Self: Sized;

    /// Clears the buffer.
    fn flush(&mut self);

    /// Records one event.
    fn record(&self, event: &str);
}
